facts.fact: Botswana sent a delegation, led by its Ambassador to Zimbabwe, to the second African Preparatory Meeting (APM26-2) convened by the African Telecommunications Union in Victoria Falls on 27-29 May 2026, which drew 35 ATU member states, and took part in the discussions on common African positions.

systems.tiers: Botswana is campaigning for a seat for candidate Basebi Mosinyi for 2027-2030; global body, not won

note: Botswana attended an ATU meeting (member); its ITU RRB seat bid is a global body and the seat is not won.
